name: Transform-Aware Sparse Voxel Directed Acyclic Graph (TSVDAG)
aliases: Transform-Aware Sparse Voxel Directed Acyclic Graphs (TSVDAG)
definition: A voxel graph structure that extends SVDAG by allowing destructive translations, mirror symmetry, and axis permutations on child pointers to reduce memory usage during compression.
summary: TSVDAG extends SVDAG by detecting repeating geometry via destructive translations and symmetries, enabling higher compression for repetitive scenes at the cost of increased preprocessing and rendering overhead.
